video.creator: Kamilah Stevenson
video.title: XRP Was Just Approved as acceptable collateral for federally regulated derivatives

interpretation: XRP is accepted by this specific clearinghouse schedule.
XRP receives a materially higher haircut and lower stated notional limit than BTC and ETH.
This is not evidence of CFTC-wide XRP approval or actual customer use.
The schedule does not list gold, U.S. Treasuries or major FX; equal risk-class wording is unsupported by this schedule.

conditions: FCM must file notice of intent and start date with CFTC MPD through WinJammer.
For each FCM's first three months of reliance, only payment stablecoins, BTC and ETH may be accepted from customers.
After the initial three-month period, other non-security digital assets accepted by a registered DCO may be considered subject to continuing conditions and DCO valuation/haircuts.
If multiple DCOs accept the same asset, the FCM applies the highest applicable DCO haircut.
Payment stablecoins may be used as proprietary residual interest only with applicable capital charge; this is not a general license to invest customer funds in stablecoins.
CFTC FAQ clarifies limits for uncleared swaps; do not generalize cleared-derivatives relief to all OTC derivatives.
regulation.xrp_specificity: No CFTC-wide XRP approval. Bitnomial's DCO schedule is the venue-specific acceptance evidence.
regulation.coinbase_actual_use: NOT_ESTABLISHED; no FCM notice, XRP customer balance or Bitnomial clearing relationship verified.

ownership_and_strategy.third_party_clearing: Payward says Bitnomial's third-party clearing operations remain intact.
ownership_and_strategy.strategic_inference: Payward now controls a US digital-asset-native derivatives stack with an XRP-accepting DCO; this is a competitive infrastructure position, not proof of XRP volume.

ripple_and_stablecoins.announcement_claim: XRP and RLUSD margin deposits available for institutional clients, subject to regulatory approvals.
ripple_and_stablecoins.rlusd_reconciliation: Older announcement includes RLUSD; current accepted-collateral schedule omits it. Treat current RLUSD eligibility as unresolved.
ripple_and_stablecoins.circle_usdc: USDC is a candidate payment stablecoin under the CFTC framework subject to GENIUS Act permitted-issuer requirements; no Circle-specific FCM collateral use was established.

relationships.coinbase_to_cftc: Coinbase Financial Markets originated the no-action request; no evidence it currently accepts XRP collateral.
relationships.bitnomial_to_xrp: Specific DCO accepts XRP at 40% haircut/$15M stated limit.
relationships.ripple_to_bitnomial: Historical company announcement of XRP/RLUSD margin availability; current RLUSD schedule unresolved.
relationships.circle_to_xrp_collateral: No direct Circle/XRP collateral usage established.

competing_hypotheses.statement: XRP collateral eligibility can improve institutional utility and collateral mobility.
support: Bitnomial current DCO schedule lists XRP.
CFTC Letter 26-05 allows FCMs to recognize DCO-accepted non-security digital assets subject to conditions.
counterevidence: FCM notice and customer usage are not verified.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Payward's Bitnomial acquisition creates a strategic advantage over Coinbase in native US derivatives clearing.
support: Payward owns FCM/DCM/DCO stack and distributes through Kraken/NinjaTrader/Payward Services.
counterevidence: Coinbase originated CFTC Letter 26-05 and may access DCO-approved assets under conditions.
No comparative market share, customer balances or execution volumes are available.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Coinbase's CFTC request creates a pathway for Coinbase FCM to accept XRP if it files notice and uses an XRP-accepting DCO.
support: Letter 26-05 was requested by Coinbase Financial Markets.
The letter references collateral accepted by a registered DCO.
counterevidence: No Coinbase notice of reliance or XRP customer collateral balance found.
Coinbase is not listed among the Bitnomial clearing members visible in the reviewed schedule.

competing_hypotheses.statement: RLUSD remains accepted collateral at Bitnomial.
support: November 3, 2025 Bitnomial announcement said RLUSD and XRP margin deposits were available.
counterevidence: October 2, 2026 accepted-collateral schedule lists XRP but omits RLUSD.
